source.title: Settings
source.description: `[tool.uv]` and `uv.toml` keys split into project metadata — `sources`, `workspace`, `dependency-groups`, `conflicts`, `build-backend` — and resolver/installer configuration like `resolution`, `prerelease`, `index-strategy`, `link-mode`, `exclude-newer`.

source.title: CLI Reference
source.description: Per-command usage, arguments, and options for `run`, `add`, `sync`, `lock`, `tool`, `python`, `pip`, `venv`, `build`, `publish`, and `auth`, including flag defaults and environment-variable equivalents.

source.title: Environment variables
source.description: Alphabetical `UV_*` reference with version-added notes, each typically mapping to a CLI flag — covering caching, index URLs, proxies, concurrency limits, Python-download mirrors, and authentication tokens.

source.title: Features
source.description: Covers `python` version management, the `run` command for scripts, `add`, `sync`, and `lock` project commands, `tool` execution via `uvx`, the legacy `pip` interface, and `cache` plus `self update` maintenance.

source.title: Working on projects
source.description: Scaffold projects with `uv init`, manage dependencies via `uv add`/`uv remove`, read `uv version`, execute through `uv run` versus `uv sync` plus activation, and build sdist/wheel artifacts with `uv build`.

source.title: Managing dependencies
source.description: `uv add`/`remove` workflows, `tool.uv.sources` (Git, URL, path, index, workspace), extras, `dependency-groups` for dev, editable and virtual installs, build requirements, and PEP 508 specifiers with environment markers.

source.title: Running commands in projects
source.description: How `uv run` executes commands in the synced `.venv`, the `--with` flag for per-invocation dependency overrides, isolated inline-metadata scripts, legacy Windows `.ps1`/`.cmd`/`.bat` scripts, and signal forwarding to child processes.

source.title: Configuration files
source.description: Discovery and precedence of `pyproject.toml` `[tool.uv]` versus `uv.toml` across project, user, and system levels; `--no-config`/`--config-file` flags, `.env` loading via `UV_ENV_FILE`, and the `[tool.uv.pip]` section.

source.title: Python versions
source.description: Managed versus system installations, `--python` requests and `.python-version` pins, `install`, `upgrade`, `find`, and `list` commands, free-threaded and debug variants, `python-preference` and `python-downloads` settings, plus CPython, PyPy, GraalPy, and Pyodide support.

source.title: Building and publishing a package
source.description: `uv build` source and wheel distributions into `dist/`, `uv version --bump` semver edits, then `uv publish` with PyPI tokens, trusted publishers, custom `[[tool.uv.index]]` targets, and PEP 740 attestations.

source.title: Using uv with pre-commit
source.description: Official `astral-sh/uv-pre-commit` hooks for `.pre-commit-config.yaml`: `uv-lock` to refresh `uv.lock`, `uv-export` to sync `requirements.txt`, and `pip-compile` with `args`/`files` for compiling multiple alternative requirements inputs.

source.title: Using uv with Jupyter
source.description: Running `jupyter lab` against a project's `.venv`, dedicated `ipykernel` kernels, standalone `uv tool run`, non-project environments, VS Code notebooks, and `!uv add` versus `!uv pip install` package installs.

source.title: Installing and managing Python
source.description: Commands to `install` specific versions or implementations like `pypy@3.10`, the `--default` executable shim, `--reinstall`, `list`, automatic on-demand downloads, `--no-managed-python` system discovery, and preview patch-version `upgrade`.

source.title: Project structure and files
source.description: Anatomy of `pyproject.toml` metadata, the gitignored `.venv` that `run` and `sync` manage, and the committed cross-platform `uv.lock` versus the standardised, tool-agnostic `pylock.toml` export target.

source.title: Creating projects
source.description: `uv init` scaffolding for `--app`, `--package`, and `--lib` layouts, `--build-backend` choices (maturin, scikit-build-core) for extension modules, the `src` structure, `py.typed` marker, and `--bare` minimal `pyproject.toml`.

source.title: Locking and syncing
source.description: Automatic locking and syncing on `uv run`, with `--locked`/`--frozen`/`--no-sync` overrides, `uv lock --check`, editable and exact installs, extras, dependency groups, `--upgrade-package`, exporting `requirements.txt`/`pylock.toml`, and `--no-install-project` partial installs for Docker.

source.title: Configuring projects
source.description: `requires-python`, entry-point scripts and plugins, `[build-system]` packaging, `tool.uv.package`, `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT`, build isolation via `extra-build-dependencies` and `no-build-isolation-package`, editable installs, `conflicts`, and `environments` markers.

source.title: Building distributions
source.description: `uv build` as a PEP 517 frontend producing sdists (`.tar.gz`) and wheels (`.whl`) into `dist/`, with `--build-constraint`, `--require-hashes` reproducibility, and the `Private :: Do Not Upload` classifier blocking PyPI.

source.title: The uv build backend
source.description: Native `uv_build` backend for pure-Python projects: `[build-system]` setup, module discovery via `module-name` and `module-root` under `src/`, namespace and `-stubs` packages, plus anchored glob include and exclude rules.

source.title: Using uv with marimo
source.description: Run marimo notebooks four ways: standalone via `uvx marimo edit`, self-contained with inline-script-metadata `--sandbox`, inside a project with `uv run`, or a non-project `venv`; plus executing notebooks headless as scripts.

source.title: Using uv in GitHub Actions
source.description: The `astral-sh/setup-uv` action with pinned versions and `enable-cache`, `setup-python` alternatives, matrix `UV_PYTHON` versions, `uv sync --locked` runs, `UV_SYSTEM_PYTHON` pip mode, private-repo PATs, and trusted publishing to PyPI.

source.title: Installing uv
source.description: Standalone `curl`/`irm` installers with version pinning, package managers (`pipx`, Homebrew, Scoop, WinGet, Cargo, Docker), `uv self update` upgrades plus `UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH`, shell autocompletion setup, and binary uninstallation steps.

source.title: Running scripts
source.description: Execute standalone files with `uv run`, per-invocation `--with` deps, PEP 723 inline metadata via `uv add --script`, `requires-python` selection, shebang executables, `uv lock`, `exclude-newer` reproducibility, and Windows `.pyw` GUI scripts.

source.title: Tools
source.description: Ephemeral `uvx`/`uv tool run` versus persistent `uv tool install` on `PATH`; disposable cached environments, version pinning (`ruff@latest`), `upgrade`, `--with`, `--with-executables-from`, and how it differs from `uv run`.

source.title: Using tools
source.description: One-off `uvx` runs in temporary isolated environments, `--from` for mismatched package names and git sources, `command@version` pinning, extras, `uv tool install`/`upgrade`, `--python` selection, and legacy Windows scripts.

source.title: Caching
source.description: How uv caches registry, Git, and local dependencies; invalidation with `--refresh`, `--reinstall`, and `tool.uv.cache-keys`; `cache clean`/`prune --ci` cleanup; cache-directory resolution via `UV_CACHE_DIR`; and versioned buckets.

source.title: Storage
source.description: Platform-specific `XDG`/Known Folder locations for cache, persistent data, config, and executable directories, plus `UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR`, `UV_TOOL_DIR`, and other env vars overriding where Python versions, tools, and `.venv` environments live.

source.title: Using uv with Dependabot
source.description: Configuring `dependabot.yml` with the `uv` `package-ecosystem` to auto-update `uv.lock`, scheduling `weekly` checks, and pairing `cooldown` with `exclude-newer` to avoid unlockable pull requests.
